exact_results: The coordinatewise inclusion x -> (i -> Complex.ofReal(x_i)) is represented by the actual real continuous linear map realCoordinateEmbedding, with exact coercion equality and actual real-unit-vector to complex-unit-vector identity.
Local right composition of iterated derivatives is proved over any nontrivially normed scalar field, generalizing the separate preserved complex-only lemma.
For finite iota, local complex ContDiffAt of finite order n at coordinatewise-real z implies local real ContDiffAt of the actual real-coordinate restriction.

For any actual coordinate word w:Fin n->iota, the real iterated derivative of the real-coordinate restriction evaluated on real Pi.single unit vectors equals the complex iterated derivative at coordinatewise-real z evaluated on corresponding complex unit vectors.
proof: Restrict scalars from Complex to Real for the ambient complex-coordinate derivative using the pinned ContDiffAt.restrictScalars_iteratedFDeriv theorem. Apply the local real linear-composition rule to the literal coordinate embedding, then use its exact unit-vector identities.
semantic_checks: Both derivatives are the actual Mathlib iteratedFDeriv objects over their advertised scalar fields and domains. The complex-valued codomain is retained in the real restriction.
Only local complex smoothness at the image point is assumed. Neither global smoothness nor a derivative equality is a hypothesis.
The actual coordinatewise embedding, actual evaluation point and actual coordinate unit directions are explicit in the final theorem.
Finite coordinate dimension and order zero are included; no new numerical factor is introduced by the equality.

The embedding definition itself is valid even without Fintype in the expanded declaration; its two wrapper theorems retain harmless Fintype section instances. The derivative theorems genuinely use finite Pi normed spaces.
DecidableEq iota is explicit where Pi.single is used, and is available for the intended Fin 3 + Fin d coordinates.
